detail.longDescription: I've been building Midline (usemidline.com) — a multi-tenant gateway that sits between your API sources and endpoints, inspecting, classifying, and logging every request (webhooks included) before it gets forwarded. If you've ever lost sleep over a flaky webhook, a silent payload drop, or just not knowing what's actually hitting your endpoints — this is for that. I'm opening it up for early testers right now. Would love for a few DEV folks to poke at it, break it, and tell me what's missing. 🔗 usemidline.com Drop a comment or DM if you want early access — feedback (good or brutal) very welcome 🙏 showdev # api # webdev # buildinpublic # api # buildinpublic # security # showdev # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community Just shipped: Midline — a security & observability gateway for your APIs 🛡️
